mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate serves as a continuous proxy for monetary policy stance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months signals an economic contraction, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad economic slowdown, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to prolonged corporate revenue pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% month-over-month) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as robust employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% m/m (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to inflation data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% yoy (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
